chapterInfo.content:
13
Nyansa ne nkwaseasɛm
1 # Mmb 1.8; 12.1 Ɔba nyansafoɔ tie agya atenetene,
na ɔfɛdifoɔ deɛ ɔntie ntwianimu.
2 # Mmb 12.14 Onipa anomu aba so na ɔdi nnepa,
na deɛ nkontompofoɔ kra pɛ ne mmusuo.
3 # Mmb 12.18; 21.23 Deɛ ɔkora n’ano hwɛ ne kra so,
na deɛ ɔtrɛ n’anomu no nya ɔsɛeɛ.
4 # Mmb 10.4 Onihafoɔ kra kɔn dɔ, na ɔnnya,
na nsiyɛfoɔ kra deɛ ɔbɛdɔre sradeɛ.
5Ɔteneneeni tane atorosɛm,
na abɔnefoɔ yɛ aniwudeɛ ne ahohoradeɛ.
6Tenenee kora deɛ ne kwan yɛ pɛ,
na abɔnefosɛm butu ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ.
7 # Mat 5.3; Adi 2.9; 3.17 Obi yɛ ne ho defoɔ, nso na ɔnni hwee,
obi nso yɛ ne ho hiani, nso na ɔwɔ adeɛ pii.
8Obi kra agyedeɛ ne n’ahonyadeɛ,
na ohiani deɛ, ɔnte ntwianim.
9 # Mmb 24.20; Hiob 5.14; 18.5-6, 18 Teneneefoɔ hann dɛre anigyeɛ,
na abɔnefoɔ kanea deɛ ɛbɛdum.
10 # Mmb 28.25; 1.6 Ahantan de ntɔkwa nko na ɛba,
na wɔn a wɔtie afotuo deɛ, nyansa ne wɔn te.
11Ahonyadeɛ a ɛfiri ahuhudeɛ mu sua,
na deɛ ɔde ne nsa ano boaboa ano no ma no dɔ.
12Anidasoɔ a ɛkyɛre muba ma akoma yare,
na anigyinadeɛ a ɛba mu yɛ nkwa dua.
13Deɛ ɔbu asɛm animtia de ɔsɛeɛ ba ne ho so,
na deɛ ɔsuro mmara no deɛ, ɔbɛnya akatua.
14 # Mmb 10.11; 14.27 Onyansafoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nkwa asutire,
sɛ onipa de bɛfiri owuo fidie mu.
15Nimdeɛ pa ma onipa anim ba nyam,
na nkontompofoɔ kwan deɛ ɛyɛ aboabo.
16 # Mmb 12.23; 15.2 Onitefoɔ yɛ n’adeɛ nyinaa nimdeɛ mu,
na ɔkwasea deɛ ɔtrɛtrɛ n’agyimisɛm mu.
17Ɔbɔfoɔ bɔne hwe amaneɛ mu,
na ɔsomafoɔ nokwafoɔ deɛ ɔsa yadeɛ.
18 # Mmb 12.1 Ohia ne aniwuo ka deɛ ɔpo atenetene,
na deɛ ɔbu animka no nya animuonyam.
19Akɔnnɔdeɛ a nsa aka yɛ ɔkra dɛ,
na bɔne mu fire yɛ nkwaseafoɔ akyiwadeɛ.
20Ɛne anyansafoɔ mmɔ, na dane onyansani,
na deɛ ɔne nkwaseafoɔ bɔ no hunu amane.
21Bɔne ti nnebɔneyɛfoɔ,
na ateneneefoɔ deɛ, ɔde papa tua wɔn ka.
22 # Mmb 14.14, 19; 28.8; Ɔsɛ 2.26 Onipa pa gya n’adeɛ ma mma mma,
na ɔdebɔneyɛni ahonyadeɛ deɛ, wɔtia ma ɔteneneeni.
23Ahiafoɔ mfuo ma aduane pii ba,
nanso atɛntenenee nni hɔ a, wɔpra kɔ.
24 # Mmb 22.15 Deɛ ɔkora n’abaa tane ne ba,
na deɛ ɔdɔ no no, tene no ntɛm so.
25 # Dwom 34.10 Ɔteneneeni bɛdidi ama ne kra amee,
na abɔnefoɔ yafunu bɛda mpan.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɔba nyansafoɔ tie agya atenetene,
na ɔfɛdifoɔ deɛ ɔntie ntwianimu.
Onipa anomu aba so na ɔdi nnepa,
na deɛ nkontompofoɔ kra pɛ ne mmusuo.
Deɛ ɔkora n’ano hwɛ ne kra so,
na deɛ ɔtrɛ n’anomu no nya ɔsɛeɛ.
Onihafoɔ kra kɔn dɔ, na ɔnnya,
na nsiyɛfoɔ kra deɛ ɔbɛdɔre sradeɛ.
Ɔteneneeni tane atorosɛm,
na abɔnefoɔ yɛ aniwudeɛ ne ahohoradeɛ.
Tenenee kora deɛ ne kwan yɛ pɛ,
na abɔnefosɛm butu ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ.
Obi yɛ ne ho defoɔ, nso na ɔnni hwee,
obi nso yɛ ne ho hiani, nso na ɔwɔ adeɛ pii.
Obi kra agyedeɛ ne n’ahonyadeɛ,
na ohiani deɛ, ɔnte ntwianim.
Teneneefoɔ hann dɛre anigyeɛ,
na abɔnefoɔ kanea deɛ ɛbɛdum.
Ahantan de ntɔkwa nko na ɛba,
na wɔn a wɔtie afotuo deɛ, nyansa ne wɔn te.
Ahonyadeɛ a ɛfiri ahuhudeɛ mu sua,
na deɛ ɔde ne nsa ano boaboa ano no ma no dɔ.
Anidasoɔ a ɛkyɛre muba ma akoma yare,
na anigyinadeɛ a ɛba mu yɛ nkwa dua.
Deɛ ɔbu asɛm animtia de ɔsɛeɛ ba ne ho so,
na deɛ ɔsuro mmara no deɛ, ɔbɛnya akatua.
Onyansafoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nkwa asutire,
sɛ onipa de bɛfiri owuo fidie mu.
Nimdeɛ pa ma onipa anim ba nyam,
na nkontompofoɔ kwan deɛ ɛyɛ aboabo.
Onitefoɔ yɛ n’adeɛ nyinaa nimdeɛ mu,
na ɔkwasea deɛ ɔtrɛtrɛ n’agyimisɛm mu.
Ɔbɔfoɔ bɔne hwe amaneɛ mu,
na ɔsomafoɔ nokwafoɔ deɛ ɔsa yadeɛ.
Ohia ne aniwuo ka deɛ ɔpo atenetene,
na deɛ ɔbu animka no nya animuonyam.
Akɔnnɔdeɛ a nsa aka yɛ ɔkra dɛ,
na bɔne mu fire yɛ nkwaseafoɔ akyiwadeɛ.
Ɛne anyansafoɔ mmɔ, na dane onyansani,
na deɛ ɔne nkwaseafoɔ bɔ no hunu amane.
Bɔne ti nnebɔneyɛfoɔ,
na ateneneefoɔ deɛ, ɔde papa tua wɔn ka.
Onipa pa gya n’adeɛ ma mma mma,
na ɔdebɔneyɛni ahonyadeɛ deɛ, wɔtia ma ɔteneneeni.
Ahiafoɔ mfuo ma aduane pii ba,
nanso atɛntenenee nni hɔ a, wɔpra kɔ.
Deɛ ɔkora n’abaa tane ne ba,
na deɛ ɔdɔ no no, tene no ntɛm so.
Ɔteneneeni bɛdidi ama ne kra amee,
na abɔnefoɔ yafunu bɛda mpan.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
